:::: {.callout-note collapse='false' title="Test comments with `testServer()`"}

::: {style='font-size: 1.10em;'}

The `testServer()` documentation has [examples](https://shiny.posit.co/r/articles/improve/server-function-testing/) of using `cat()` to create custom messages. I put a function for creating `testServer()` messages (`test_cmt()`) in the [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/modsquad/blob/main/R/utils.R) file of `modsquad` (it started as a [test helper](https://r-pkgs.org/testing-advanced.html)). 

It has two arguments (`test` and `msg`), and makes it easy to print messages to the console while I'm developing tests.

```{r}
#| eval: true 
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false 
#| comment: ""
test_cmt(test = "mod_server_function", msg = "test contents")
```


:::
